title: Regime-Dependent Breakdown of LCDM Across Cosmic Time
abstract: Combines low-z galaxy dynamics (SPARC) with high-z galaxy abundances (JWST COSMOS-Web) to test whether deviations from standard ΛCDM predictions cluster by observational regime. Using a descriptive L0–L3 taxonomy and a pre-specified chi-squared/permutation framework, the paper finds significant, monotonic high-z excesses and structured low-z rotation-curve deviations, rejecting uniform randomness (χ²=47.3, df=4, p≈1.3e-9). The result is robust to photometric-redshift resampling and conservative systematic stress tests.
